senses.gloss:
—1 N. of the people living round Gayā and the district inhabited by them.
—2 N. of an Asura.
—3 Wealth.
—4 House, household, family.
—5 Offspring, progeny.
—6 The sky.
—7 Oneʼs own place or abode.

गायः [गै भावे घञ्] Singing, a song; यथाविधानेन पठन् सामगायमविच्युतम्
 Y. 3. 112; Bhāg. 10. 90. 26.
गायः A song; यथाविधानेन पठन् सामगायमविच्युतम् Y. 3. 112.
गयः + .{@-या@} N. of a city in Behār which is a place of pilgrimage.
गयस्फान a. Ved. Promoting domestic wealth; गयस्फानो अमीवहा Rv. 1. 91. 12.

गायकः [गै-ण्वुल्]
—1 A singer, musician; न नटा न विटा न गायकाः Bh. 3. 27.
—2 An actor.

गायत्र a. Consisting in or connected with गायत्री; गर्गाद्यदुकुलाचार्याद्गायत्रं
 व्रतमास्थितौ Bhāg. 10. 45. 29.
गायत्र + .{@-त्रम्@} A song or hymn; एतद्गायत्रं प्राणेषु प्रोतम् Ch. Up. 2. 11. 1.

गायत्री + .{@-त्रम्@} A hymn composed and recited in the Gāyatrī metre.
.━{@Comp.@}: गायत्रीमन्त्रः, गायत्रीवल्लभः

—1 A Vedic metre of 24 syllables; गायत्री छन्दसामहम् Bg. 10. 35.
—2 N. of a very sacred verse repeated by every Brāhmaṇa at his Sandhyā
 (morning and evening devotions) and on other occasions also. Great sins
 even are said to be expiated by a pious repetition of this verse, which
 is as follows:− तत्सवितुर्वरेण्यं भर्गो देवस्य धीमहि धियो यो नः
 प्रचोदयात् Rv. 3. 62. 10.
—3 A number of mystical verses in Tantra literature.
—4 N. of Durgā, Ks. 53. 172.
गायत्री + -मन्त्रः prayers connected with the गायत्री.

गायत्रिन् a. (-णी f.) One who sings hymns, especially
 of the Sāmaveda; गायन्ति त्वा गायत्रिणो Rv. 1. 10. 1.
